coordination: The named Developer Mode and scheduled-task setup approval has been clarified with the owner; the setup is reported in flight. Medic retains exclusive setup/control ownership until it reports completion and explicit safe handoff readiness. Rivet's existing-state/source review remains read-only, with no duplicate setup or input.
completion_request: When finished, return the previously requested exact source/probe/version and sanitized runtime evidence, identify what actually passed, any remaining limits, and whether all active input is stopped and the route is ready for a bounded handoff. Distinguish query-only proof from capture/input and task success.
limits: Approval clarification covers the named setup changes only. It is not blanket authority for additional access, security changes, credentials, unrelated input or broader task execution. Do not transfer control implicitly; preserve one operator at a time.
reply_expectation: Completion evidence and explicit handoff-ready state, or a concrete blocker. No intermediate acknowledgment-only packet is needed.
